name: Kars
summary_text: Far-eastern border province province. No province-specific trans-related findings in this research pass; the national framework and its 2025-26 escalation apply here unchanged. The region's own sources are national-level: a leaked draft omnibus reform package (11th Judicial Package, October 2025) would create new anti-LGBT articles — criminalising conduct deemed "contrary to biological sex and general morality", restricting gender-affirming healthcare with a minimum age of 25, and enabling charges against trans people and their providers; the state's "Year of the Family" institutional programme and blanket bans on LGBTI public events are national practice, not provincial choices. Per the country research dossier, the absence of a documented provincial ban here is not evidence of tolerance — the national blanket-ban practice applies across the country.

sources.title: Türkiye: Draft Law Threatens LGBT People with Prison | Human Rights Watch
sources.claim_summary: Human Rights Watch news release (29 October 2025): a leaked draft omnibus reform package — the 11th Judicial Package — would amend the penal and civil codes with new anti-LGBT articles: criminalising behaviour "contrary to biological sex and general morality" including its so-called "promotion", raising the minimum age for gender-affirming healthcare to 25 with onerous eligibility conditions, and enabling criminal charges against trans people and the medical professionals who treat them. HRW called for immediate withdrawal of the package.

Kaos GL Association's LGBTI+ Human Rights Report 2025 (published February 2026; monitoring since 2007), titled "The Year of the Family: A Major Siege Against LGBTI+ People": in 2025 anti-LGBTI policies became institutionalised — instructions to public institutions under the "Year of the Family" banner plus religious and administrative rhetoric from senior officials created a climate that encouraged human-rights violations. National monitoring based on media-documented violations and civil-society applications.
